”Running – Getting Started” will
take anyone, at any level of fit-
ness, into the running lifestyle. Jeff
Galloway offers a step-by-step
program that is easy to use and
easy to understand. Included are
lots of tips on nutrition, staying
motivated, building endurance,
shoes, stretching and strengthening,
and much more. Jeff Galloway
has introduced over 150,000
people to running while reducing
or eliminating aches, pains, and
injuries 
suffered 
during most
training programs. 
Jeff Galloway
Running – A Year Round
Plan

You don’t have to wonder what to
do each day. This book will
organize your running life, telling
you how to run (with other
optional exercises) throughout the
year, to prepare for the goal of
your choice – even if you want to
be a more consistent runner. With
each week’s workouts, you’ll re-
ceive a motivational tip, with
suggestions about how to in-
crease your running enjoyment.
Jeff Galloway
